title: setup --help and setup hook --help print the usage on stdout and exit 0
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). `jitso setup --help` and `jitso setup hook --help` (and `-h`) print the usage with the flags `--absolute`, `--remove`, `--dry-run` and `--yes` on stdout, empty stderr, exit 0; nothing is written. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout: --absolute  write this binary's absolute path instead of the word jitso
--remove    remove the hook entries jitso added
--yes       apply without asking (needed when stdin is not a terminal)
